contracts.commit_point: Subprocess spawn of the flagged 'deno run' command: asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(*cmd, ...) in PyodideSandbox.execute and subprocess.run(cmd, ...) in SyncPyodideSandbox.execute (reached from PyodideSandboxTool._arun/_run).
contracts.declared_mechanism: BasePyodideSandbox.__init__ records deny-by-default constructor parameters and builds self.permissions from perm_defs [--allow-env, --allow-read (node_modules fallback), --allow-write (node_modules fallback), --allow-net, --allow-run, --allow-ffi] via build_permission_flag, then appends --node-modules-dir; _build_command starts ['deno','run'] and applies cmd.extend(self.permissions) so every spawn carries the flags, with Deno's runtime permission model enforcing them inside the subprocess; PyodideSandboxTool.__init__ constructs both the async and sync sandbox instances with the tool's allow_* settings.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Sandboxed untrusted code obtaining a capability the operator did not grant: --allow-env (environment variables), --allow-net (network), --allow-run (subprocess execution), --allow-ffi (foreign function interface), or unrestricted --allow-read/--allow-write beyond the node_modules fallback; every allow_* constructor parameter defaults to False, and build_permission_flag emits a flag only when the value is True or a non-empty allowlist.
pending_binding_information: No supplied view shows PyodideSandboxTool being instantiated and attached to a concrete agent graph or tool registry within this repository; mediation is grounded in the supplied BaseTool implementation, its args_schema ('code' tool-call argument), and its documented dispatch via create_react_agent/ToolNode.
Production call sites that might override the deny-by-default permissions (allow_* arguments at construction) are not present in the supplied views.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of agent-supplied Python code: PyodideSandbox.execute (async) and SyncPyodideSandbox.execute (sync), dispatched through the PyodideSandboxTool BaseTool whose _run/_arun forward the tool-call 'code' argument into the sandbox.
contracts.protected_resource: Host capabilities reachable from the Deno subprocess: environment variables, filesystem paths, network endpoints, OS process spawning, and native libraries via FFI.
contracts.protection_obligation: Untrusted Python code executed through the Pyodide/Deno sandbox — including code supplied by the PyodideSandboxTool agent tool ('python_code_sandbox') — must run with deny-by-default Deno capabilities: environment variables, network, child-process spawning, and FFI denied unless explicitly configured, and filesystem read/write confined to the configured allowlist with a node_modules fallback; the permission flags must be present on every 'deno run' command line before the sandboxed code is spawned.
scope_limits: Deny-by-default, not unconditional: constructor and docstring examples permit allow_net=True or path/domain allowlists; the guard enforces whatever permission set was configured at sandbox construction.
Filesystem defaults fall back to read and write access limited to node_modules, so writes inside node_modules are allowed even with all defaults.

The guard bounds only the Deno subprocess capability model; it does not cover host-side execution outside the sandbox, Deno's own fetching of the remote jsr: wrapper package (PKG_NAME), or resource limits (timeout_seconds, memory limit), which are separate mechanisms.
Stateful and stateless tool modes share the same sandbox execute path; stateful mode additionally requires LangGraph checkpoint state keys (session_bytes, session_metadata, messages).
